source_summary.interval_convention: Hold previous alert to next scan, exclude gaps above frame_max_gap_s, omit unknown terminal interval
source_summary.episode_convention: Contiguous inspect_obstacle/inspect_unresolved frames; not physical object events
source_summary.distance_convention: Sum pose translation norms, report valid-motion subset separately; never stitch distinct recordings

limitations: Offline policy compatibility, not policy approval or live ROS/DDS verification.
The unchanged alert burden remains unacceptable per review; it is not a labelled false-alarm rate.
The path-length denominator is an uncalibrated odometry proxy, not independent distance truth.
No object-onset labels or i7-9700E measurements are available.
